execution_policy.retrieval_failure: stop before generation; preserve failed retrieval and partial evidence
execution_policy.retries: none for jobs, requests or answers; agentic_wrapup alone may repeat one rejected selection inside its own retrieval budget
execution_policy.cache_policy: shared immutable corpus and loaded vector index; navigation/symbol tools fresh per query
execution_policy.global_budget: tighten stage admission/deadlines as remaining run budget decreases
execution_policy.budget_accounting: Actual usage/cost remain unknown when provider accounting is missing. Reserve policy uses recorded request-byte/output reservations only for future-job admission; reservations are not actual billed usage.
execution_policy.routing: pre-retrieval routers make one selection with no fallback or escalation; adaptive_cascade is not a router and is described under cascade
execution_policy.agentic_wrapup: one selection request and one tool call are held in reserve; one rejected selection may be repeated inside the same retrieval budget; no limit is raised
execution_policy.cascade: vector first; escalate once to agentic_wrapup on a failed or self-reported insufficient first stage; keep the completed first-stage answer if the second stage fails; both stages charged to the job

cascade_settings.escalate_when: first-stage retrieval or answer did not complete, or the first-stage answer did not report evidence_sufficient=true
cascade_settings.final_answer: the second-stage answer when it completes; otherwise the completed first-stage answer; otherwise the job fails
cascade_settings.inputs: first-stage statuses and the answer model's evidence_sufficient report only
cascade_settings.accounting: all requests, tokens, tool calls and elapsed time of both stages are charged
